args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate following its deploy. Rolled back all regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Rollback verified: all regions now running v2.3.0, service healthy, error rate dropped to 0.2%. v2.3.1 needs investigation before any re-deploy attempt.
args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 unhealthy in production; rolled back to v2.3.0 in all regions

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Investigated**: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks across all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. The most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.3.1-rc had only ever been healthy in staging, not production, so it wasn't a rollback candidate).
2. **Rolled back**: All regions now run v2.3.0. Verified afterward — service is healthy with error rate down to 0.2%.
3. **Incident opened**: SEV2 incident **INC-0001** for checkout-api, documenting the failed v2.3.1 deploy, the rollback to v2.3.0, and verification results. The on-call engineer has been paged.
